top_signals.title: Cyber Operators Are Deployed in Place. The Pentagon Should Treat Them That Way
top_signals.summary:
A cyber operator can spend a shift tracking an adversary halfway around the world, walk to the parking lot, and be home in time for dinner. There is no flight home, no demobilization, and no transition from an operational mission back to ordinary life. The war zone is a commute away. That arrangement looks like one of the advantages of cyber warfare.
